# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

N’fare natwagǝm alahẽn tiyomptu adwosé bǝnaars mma mantɛ m’mafaa. Swamswam n’nyé n’yaŋǝsi nem pwatǝm n’nwam a bigǝ. Tuwo kpa be katawé, a we bégaw a pwase hirbe a nwan hira ntinwé hira n’fusu u hiim.
